question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Extremely beautiful, elaborate or impressive
solution:
The correct answer is Option (2) i.e. **'Magnificent'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Extremely beautiful, elaborate or impressive: **(अत्यंत सुंदर, विस्तृत या प्रभावशाली)
 
• **Magnificent: **(भव्य) - (Extremely beautiful, elaborate, or impressive)
 
 
• **Example: **The palace was truly mag
